description.shortText: An urban traffic network of traffic lights powered by sensors, machine vision, and IoT to optimize the flow of vehicles and pedestrians. This technological solution helps solve exacerbated traffic problems, besides preventing possible accidents produced by poorly communicated traffic modes.
